The camera remains static at eye-level, focusing on her upper body and facial expressions. The lighting is focused on the food, highlighting its texture and color. (4) The scene shifts to a low-angle shot under the table. The woman is now lying on her side on the wooden floor, her head resting on a brown and yellow cushion. Her eyes are closed, appearing to be asleep or unconscious. Another person's hand enters the frame and pokes her upper arm. A large white question mark symbol is edited near her face.
